The design where authorized flash borrowers get zero premium is an intentional feature, not a vulnerability. The trust assumptions around msg.sender and params.onBehalfOf in the borrow path are standard Aave design patterns where the caller takes on debt responsibility. No exploitable vulnerabilities were identified that would allow unauthorized fund extraction or state manipulation.
